then.text: {greeting} Did the armourer give you the toy knight? He's been polishing it all week. Don't tell him it's tin.

else.text: {greeting} The Hall of Steel's a staircase tower lined with swords, pikes and breastplates, set out in patterns like a Victorian trophy wall.

then.text: You beat our armourer? Then this is yours for the market. A little tin knight from the shop. Very historically inaccurate. Very popular.

else.text: For Kirkgate? You'll have to get past the armourer first. He gives nothing away without a bout.
